title: Rank Ads by Revenue
real_world_story: An advertising platform wants to review its advertisements from highest expected revenue to lowest expected revenue before allocating premium slots.

real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Ordering advertisements to identify the highest-value opportunities

problem_statement: Given an array containing the expected revenues of N advertisements, sort the revenues in non-increasing order.
task: Arrange advertisements from the highest expected revenue to the lowest.
input_format: The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N integers representing advertisement revenues.
output_format: Print the advertisement revenues in non-increasing order.

examples.explanation: The advertisement revenues are arranged from highest to lowest.
The revenues are sorted in non-increasing order, with equal revenues appearing together.

expected_algorithm.reason: Basic sorting algorithms can be used to organize advertisements by expected revenue before slot allocation.

hint: Compare advertisement revenues that are out of order.
Swap them when the larger revenue should appear first.
Continue until the complete list is sorted.
real_world_takeaway: Sorting advertisements by expected revenue helps platforms identify high-value advertisements for premium slots.
